entries.en: U'rahtalo would confide in you about her troubles.
entries.fr: U'rahtalo semble préoccupée par quelque chose.
entries.ja: 忘れられたオアシスのウ・ラタロは、困っていることがあるようだ。

entries.en: While happily unburdened by modesty, the U tribeswomen still expect their daily ablutions in the springs to not serve as a local attraction. Confront all the unwanted onlookers with /furious indignation.
entries.fr: U'rahtalo vous a dit qu'elle se sentait observée. La Miqo'te voudrait que vous inspectiez les alentours de l'Oasis et que vous sermonniez les individus qui se rincent l'œil. Montrez aux voyeurs que vous êtes <italic(1)>furieu<if(gnum4,se,x)><italic(0)>.
entries.ja: 水浴び中に感じる視線が気になっているというウ・ラタロ。水浴びを覗いている男たちを全員見つけ、エモート「怒る」をしよう。
entries.frMacro: U'rahtalo vous a dit qu'elle se sentait observée. La Miqo'te voudrait que vous inspectiez les alentours de l'Oasis et que vous sermonniez les individus qui se rincent l'œil. Montrez aux voyeurs que vous êtes <italic(1)>furieu<if(gnum4,se,x)><italic(0)>.

entries.en: Your righteous indignation has caused the oglers to flee for their lives. Anger is a gift, and it seems that the Twelve have been generous with your share. Make pleasant your countenance, and report the happy news to U'rahtalo.
entries.fr: Vous avez fait les gros yeux à tous les individus qui reluquaient les belles Miqo'tes. Portez la bonne nouvelle à U'rahtalo.
entries.ja: 覗きをしていた男たちを全員追い出した。忘れられたオアシスの「ウ・ラタロ」に報告しよう。

entries.en: U'rahtalo is well glad to be free of the madding crowd. However, it seems that she was not <italic(1)>completely<italic(0)> averse to the attention she was being offered.
entries.macro: U'rahtalo is well glad to be free of the madding crowd. However, it seems that she was not <italic(1)>completely<italic(0)> averse to the attention she was being offered.
entries.fr: Grâce à vous, U'rahtalo va pouvoir profiter de sa baignade et se détendre après sa journée de chasse.
entries.ja: 覗きがいなくなり、喜んでいる様子のウ・ラタロ。これでゆっくり水浴びできるといいのだが……。

entries.en: Confront the oglers with a /furious anger.
entries.fr: Faire le <italic(1)>/furieux<italic(0)> sur les voyeurs
entries.ja: 覗いている人々に「怒る」をする

entries.en: Report to U'rahtalo.

entries.en: My sisters and I like to bathe here after a hunt, but lately, there have been oglers about. I've leapt out of the water to chase them off, but this only seems to swell their ranks! Will you chase them down and show them how <colortype(500)><edgecolortype(501)>furious<edgecolortype(0)><colortype(0)> I am?
